purpose: generate attribute-preserving binding interventions with affected and invariant questions before any new model training

train.use: answer-only and intervention-training development after separate training authorization

selection_dev.use: bounded model and hyperparameter selection only

final_test.use: sealed until methods and checkpoints are frozen

challenges.shape_color_swap: swap colors across different shapes while preserving symbolic color and shape multisets; rendered RGB histogram mismatch is measured and reported
challenges.position_color_swap: swap colors across identical target shapes at different positions; rendered RGB histogram must be exactly preserved

question_contract.affected: one yes-to-no and one no-to-yes question
question_contract.invariant: two yes-to-yes and two no-to-no questions

claim_boundary: Generated scenes are controlled synthetic mechanism data. They do not establish natural-image transfer, model improvement, or method novelty.
